name: 火山の柱状玄武岩
notes: Joined staggered columns retain broad vertical planes, broken tops, weathering, and the original common rubble foot.

Trimmed the bottom 2 percent of the dense reconstruction to remove folded underside artifacts and capped the existing intersection contour. Outer silhouette and column tops retained; no primitive replacement.
The reduced source is a visual game mesh, not a watertight fabrication solid. Seven exact neutral and clay views show no visible missing columns or open silhouette.
Accepted one 15,460-triangle distant LOD. The second generated LOD is byte-identical, so it remains in production history and is not loaded twice.
Original source UV/albedo retained; metallic 0 and roughness 0.91. Approximately 4.6 metres high. Static model without unnecessary rig or animation.

provenance.reconstruction: Local TRELLIS-2; preserved dense reconstruction, source-derived reduction and separate revisions.
